incident: docs promised <=1 IMSLP req/s; build_dump paced 0.1-0.15s; caught at first runner refresh, cancelled before IMSLP traffic
fix: per-host min interval in request_json + Retry-After
lesson: verify quantitative claims in docs/briefs against executing code before outward-facing actions

incident: runner refresh failed after 2h crawl: offline overrides step needed Wikidata entities a cold crawl never fetches; local e2e had a warm cache
fix: preflight refetch_override_entities.py as first refresh step
lesson: e2e must match production cache state; validate offline inputs as preflight before long network phases

incident: labelling CLIs ran with the repo root as cwd; codex read-only sandbox and cursor ask mode can still read the dump holding the reference labels
fix: run each labelling call from an empty temp dir (cursor-agent then needs --trust)
lesson: for labelling/eval work, isolate the agent's filesystem from the answer key; read-only is not blind

incident: pgrep after setsid nohup recorded the launcher's PID; the kill -0 waiter fired at once (false 'driver died')
fix: re-read the PID of the python process
lesson: detached drivers should write their own PID file (os.getpid()) instead of being found with pgrep

incident: pilot cost extrapolation overestimated: Codex ~720 tokens/label in the pilot vs ~370 in the full pass; 5h pool 2.3 vs 1.5 pts per 100 labels
fix: per-chunk quota gates (pause on codex-5h floor, stop on 7d/auto floors) instead of trusting the estimate
lesson: quota gauges are whole-percent and small pilots are noisy; gate long runs per chunk and log quota per chunk to measure the real cost

incident: target repo had mixed CRLF/LF/mixed line endings; delegate apply failed with git apply and with --3way
fix: checked main-tree files equal base, copied changed files from the worktree; repo then normalised with .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf, *.ipynb -text) + git add --renormalize as its own commit
lesson: launch should warn on CRLF/mixed bases; apply could fall back to file copy when every touched file still equals its base blob

incident: delegate cost --repo showed 1 of 5 runs: copy-merged, read-only and review runs never reach runs.jsonl
fix: none yet; usage collected by hand from meta.json and review-1/meta.json
lesson: log usage when a run or review finishes (or on cleanup), not only on apply

incident: brief's acceptance criterion (morph pairings preserve sum of amp^2) was physically wrong at the onset: duplicated partials start phase-coherent; Codex implemented it literally and the cross-vendor review approved it as spec-compliant
fix: orchestrator caught it on its own read; test marked provisional and the criterion turned into a user decision in the plan
lesson: review checks patch vs brief and cannot catch brief errors; for domain criteria add a review focus that challenges the brief's acceptance criteria, or ask the user first

incident: audit wrote 11 notebook copies to .audit/ inside the worktree; exit packet reported 1016 files / +18.3M lines

incident: auto-mode classifier denied `git rm` of tracked dump files and then the follow-up commit; work sat uncommitted until the user approved

lesson: in auto mode, bundle destructive/outward git steps (rm of tracked data, commit, push, PR, merge, tag) into one explicit approval request at the end of a work item
